title: Marketing Segments
notes: No relation fields, phone/address/currency inputs, or messaging in this slice — segments have no such fields, so those contract items are N/A rather than unmet. GET /segments/:id/contacts now powers a matching-contacts preview in the detail drawer; POST /segments/:id/refresh-count now powers a Refresh count row action and drawer button. Edit form now loads via GET /segments/:id and saves via PUT /segments/:id (previously used list+create as a broken upsert). Count preview on create/edit uses create+refresh-count+delete as a dry run since no dedicated preview endpoint exists — acceptable but has a brief side-effect window.
showcaseScript: Build a segment with rules on destination and spend
Refresh the count and preview matching contacts
Launch a campaign to that segment
